question: In the sewage sludge co-incineration run with the highest incineration temperature, what gas velocity and P/Fe/Na ratio were used?
rendered:
According to page 3, Table 2 (not shown), the experiment with the highest incineration temperature was run at 900 °C. The row for this experiment states:

- temperature/ °C particle size/μm gas velocity/U/Umf P/Fe/Na heavy metals 
- 1 800 650 1.3 0.4/3/1 Cu, Pb 
- 2 850 650 1.3 0.4/3/1 Cu, Pb 
- 3 900 650 1.3 0.4/3/1 Cu, Pb 

So, in the sewage sludge co-incineration run with the highest incineration temperature (900 °C), the gas velocity used was 1.3 Umf and the P/Fe/Na ratio was 0.4/3/1.
